record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.kind: on-stage-start effect (between rounds) on the board Pokémon; stack-based stat drift with a bench reset
record.summary: Passive.FUR_COAT has one PassiveEffects entry, FurCoatEffect, an OnStageStartEffect applied to every Pokémon of the player's board at the start of each picking phase. On the board (positionY not 0) and while stacks < stacksRequired, each stage lowers the Pokémon's speed by 5 (not below 0), raises its def by 2 and adds 1 stack; with stacks already at stacksRequired nothing more happens. On the bench (positionY 0), speed and def are reset to the class base values (read from a fresh instance of the Pokémon's class), and if stacks >= stacksRequired the stacks are cleared and a Silk Scarf is pushed to the player's items; stacks are set to 0 in any case. stacksRequired is 5 for FURFROU and 10 for WOOLOO and DUBWOOL. The changes are written directly to the board Pokémon's speed, def and stacks fields, not through addSpeed / addDefense, so these amounts are applied as written: no AP, crit, Big Eater Belt or Twist Band helper is involved, and there is no upper clamp on def (speed has a floor of 0 only).
triggers: Start of each picking phase, once per Pokémon on the board or bench (OnStageStartEffect)

effects.declaredRaw: speed -5 and def +2 per stage while stacks < stacksRequired, on the board
effects.scaling: none (fixed amounts, one stack per stage)
effects.resolution: applied as written to the board Pokémon: speed = max(0, speed - 5), def += 2, stacks += 1; no stat helper is used so these amounts are requested = applied

effects.declaredRaw: back to class base speed and def, stacks to 0 when on the bench
effects.resolution: base values come from a new instance of the Pokémon's class (PokemonClasses[pokemon.name]); the reset replaces any other permanent speed or def change on that Pokémon

effects.declaredRaw: Silk Scarf when benched with stacks >= stacksRequired
effects.resolution: Silk Scarf pushed to player.items, once per bench reset; stacks then restart from 0

conditions: Applies per Pokémon, at stage start, regardless of fights or items.
Bench and board are told apart only by positionY === 0.
Stacks stop at stacksRequired on the board: later stages change nothing until the Pokémon is on the bench.
If a Pokémon with fewer than stacksRequired stacks is benched, the stats reset but no Silk Scarf is given.
The player must exist for the Silk Scarf to be given; the stat reset does not depend on it.
record.resetBehaviour: Stacks and the speed / def changes are reset only by a stage start with the Pokémon on the bench (stacks to 0, speed and def to class base).
